[Act: companies
 Chapter: Prevention of Oppression and Mismanagement
 Section: 246::Application of certain provisions to proceedings under section 241 or section 245.
]


The provisions of sections 337 to 341 (both inclusive) shall apply mutatis mutandis, in relation to an application made to the Tribunal under section 241 or section 245.

metadata.section_title: Application of certain provisions to proceedings under section 241 or section 245.
